2. “Be able to monitor it well (We have a local dashboard)”
3. “Develop further”
4. “Make development more clearer.”

“You will be the main agent going forward, so please setup as we embark ion this journey. Create intent or any other files. Ensure we clean everythuign as we begin development.”

## Outcome

A new session can resume from the roadmap, reproduce engine verification,
inspect production runs locally, and identify the next bounded change and its
proof. Clean up contradictory navigation and status without erasing history.

## Boundaries

Preserve Verify / Act authority, canonical documents, unmerged proposals,
applied migrations, and pre-existing local work. This setup authorizes local
verification and workflow/monitoring fixes; it does not decide E11, invent E17
approval evidence, rotate credentials, deploy, or launch the product.
